title: Apply the exact small-compliance envelope while charging stiffness escape
statement: At m=1,M=2,K=1,theta=1/2, every admitted finite network obeys Jrigid-J<=(eta0/4) C_CM. The coefficient lies in [0.398643595583964859020343,0.398643595583964859020344] and is sharp for the unrestricted-stiffness infimum as Ccap decreases to zero. A legal positive two-branch sequence realizes the leading slope while spending H_C=Ccap^(-2).

requires: Connected finite positive scalar spring/mass networks with one rank-one intercell backbone link
Full-spectrum ideal-contact harmonic ballistic Bose objective
Defined relative-CM compliance, fixed actual masses and supplied positive K/theta
Fixed normalized source resources and no common finite spring cap
Exact r0/eta0 double-root objects in p13 PROOF Section 5, not free decimal parameters
provides: Uniform all-network saving envelope and exact limiting slope
A positive compliance-correct family proving sharpness
Pendant slope g(sqrt2)/sqrt2 about 0.3776791972066011; ratio about 1.05550848 compares leading savings only
assumptions: No vector, anharmonic, finite-contact, connector-mass, geometry/strain or measured-device transfer
No historical-priority or algorithmic advantage established; conventional designers receive the same synthesis information
Saving itself vanishes linearly: not a 5.55 percent reduction of total conductance
Finite-stiffness/material claims lie outside this asymptotic optimum
costs: Sharp family spends unbounded stiffness C^(-2), retaining every high band
Exact double-root/sign and Bose-tail certificates; no free precision or measured performance
contract.units: Normalized mass/frequency units; scale both coefficient and compliance consistently before physical use
contract.obstruction: Rigorous asymptotic benchmark exposing a hidden stiffness cost; no finite-budget or physical-device advantage.

evidence.range_scope: Three-moment dual, exact target/no-improvement result, sharp slope and stiff sequence; later joint source supersedes only its named open point.

body: The double-root dual proves the envelope and an explicit finite-star sequence proves sharpness. Full-frequency signs and high-band tails, not sampled optimization, carry the result.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
